signals.source: rotating-expert-review 2026-11-07 mobile-rn (dispatcher Tier-1d, ingested by routine Phase 2)
evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/widgets/WidgetDataProvider.ts:373-380 — private apiRequest<T>() wraps the whole fetch in try/catch and, on ANY error (rejected fetch = offline/timeout/DNS, or a thrown `API request failed: <status>` for a non-2xx), returns `{} as T` instead of re-throwing.

Consequence: updateAllWidgets() (lines 136-160) wraps fetchWidgetData() in try/catch to classify each widget as success/failure, but because apiRequest never throws, the failure path is dead code — a failed backend fetch resolves to an empty payload, is treated as `success: true`, cached, and overwrites previously-valid cached widget data.
Fix vector: make apiRequest throw (remove the `{} as T` fallback); or move the fallback decision into fetchWidgetData with an explicit mock-mode flag.

signals.source: rotating-expert-review 2026-11-07 mobile-rn (dispatcher Tier-1d, ingested by routine Phase 2)
evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/nfc/NFCAccessController.ts (478 lines) — security-sensitive physical building-access controller has NO sibling or repo-wide test file.

Latent correctness concern: handleTap() only flips a granted result to denied inside `if (NativeNFC) { ... }`. When NativeNFC is null, the transmit step is skipped but validationResult.granted stays true, so the code logs 'granted' and calls updateCredentialUsage() even though no credential was transmitted.
Fix vector: add NFCAccessController.test.ts covering validateAccess() grant/deny/expiry branches, the NativeNFC-null path, and logAccessAttempt() status mapping.

signals.source: rotating-expert-review 2026-11-07 mobile-rn (dispatcher Tier-1d, ingested by routine Phase 2)
evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/widgets/WidgetDataProvider.ts:351 (getAllCachedData) and :94 (getAllWidgetConfigs) — both do `return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : {}` / `: []` with NO try/catch. A corrupted blob throws SyntaxError that propagates up and breaks every widget read until storage is cleared.
Inconsistency: sibling persistence modules in the same app DO guard JSON.parse (TourManager.ts:289-294, NFCCredentialManager.ts:226/353/366, HelpCenter.ts:199).
Fix vector: wrap both JSON.parse calls in try/catch, log warn, return empty default on parse failure — matching the sibling modules.
